en.title: Waymo Faces Accessibility Law Claims as Transit and Tech Funding Boost Disability Inclusion
en.summary: Disability activists allege that Waymo's autonomous vehicle launch in Nevada violates accessibility laws, failing to accommodate users with disabilities. Meanwhile, Taichung extends a NT$2.16 million home accessibility subsidy through October, and the Cleveland RTA secures $20 million to upgrade its Green Line for full accessibility. Additional highlights include new accessibility features at Highmark Stadium, a BiblioCommons-Level Access partnership for improved library platforms, and research showing biometric systems can still fail accessibility tests despite high accuracy.

highlights.title: Waymo’s Nevada Rollout Violates Accessibility Law, Disability Activist Claims - Streetsblog USA
Taichung extends home accessibility subsidy up to NT$2.16 million through October 31
RTA awarded $20M in grants to make entire Green Line accessible for people with disabilities
New Highmark Stadium puts accessibility front and center for Bills fans
BiblioCommons Partners With Level Access to Overhaul Its Accessibility Approaches
A biometric system can be accurate and still fail an accessibility test - Biometric Update

zh-TW.title: Waymo 無障礙爭議 台中補助延長
zh-TW.summary: 殘障人士活動者指控 Waymo 在內華達州的自動駕駛車輛推出違反無障礙法律，未能適當容納殘障使用者。同時，台中市將居家無障礙補助延長至 10 月 31 日，最高補助金額為 216 萬元；克利夫蘭 RTA 亦獲得 2000 萬美元用於升級 Green Line 無障礙設施。其他亮點包括新 Highmark 體育場以無障礙設計迎接球迷、BiblioCommons 與 Level Access 合作改善圖書館平台無障礙性，以及研究顯示生物識別系統雖準確仍可能無法通過無障礙測試。

highlights.title: Waymo 在內華達州的推廣違反無障礙法，殘障人士活動者指控 - Streetsblog USA
台中市延長居家無障礙最高補助216萬元，截止10月31日
克利夫蘭地區交通局獲得2000萬美元補助金，使整條Green Line對殘障人士無障礙
新Highmark體育場將無障礙放在首位，為比爾斯球迷提供便利
BiblioCommons 與 Level Access 合作全面改進其無障礙方案
生物識別系統可能準確但仍無法通過無障礙測試 - Biometric Update
